The '''2020 Copa Sudamericana final stages''' were played from 24 November 2020 to 23 January 2021.<ref name="calendar_new">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_version_pos_pandemia_06_07_2020_aprobado_consejo.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-final-unica-se-disputara-el-23-de-enero-en-el-mario-alberto-kempes|title=La Final Única se disputará el 23 de enero en el Mario Alberto Kempes|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=9 November 2020|language=es}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2020 Copa Sudamericana]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/docs2020/Manual-de-Clubes-Sudamericana-2020-es.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|language=es}}</ref> with the final played in [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]], [[Argentina]] at the [[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-designa-maracana-rio-y-mario-kempes-cordoba-sedes-de-las-finales-unicas-de-libertadores-y|title=El Maracaná (Río) y el Mario Kempes (Córdoba) sedes de las Finales Únicas de Libertadores y Sudamericana 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 October 2019}}</ref>

The final stages had been originally scheduled to be played from 21 July to 7 November 2020, but were postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_aprobado_consejo_13_06_2019.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Qualified teams==
The 16 winners of the [[2020 Copa Sudamericana second stage|second stage]] advanced to the round of 16.

===Seeding===
<section begin=Seeding />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams are seeded according to the second stage draw, with each team assigned a "seed" 1–16 corresponding to the tie they win (O1–O16) (Regulations Article 2.2.2.1).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Seeding />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarterfinals, and semifinals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.2). If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] will be used. If still tied, [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.2).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.2.3). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<section end=Format />
